description: Paper 2: Global Time Echoes: 25-Year Analysis of CODE Precise Clock Products
impact: Enhanced manuscript integrity by ensuring all reported analyses have been performed
short_description: Global Time Echoes: 25-Year Analysis of CODE Precise Clock Products. Extended analysis of 165.2M measurements over 25.3 years confirms temporal stability and reveals long-period geophysical coupling including 18.6-year nutation cycle.
long_description:
Analysis of 25.3 years of global GNSS timing data (165.2 million station pairs) documents persistent velocity-dependent correlations in atomic clock networks. Seven independent signatures are identified including spatial anisotropy, orbital velocity coupling, CMB frame alignment, and lunar nutation. Observed patterns are compatible with key a priori TEP predictions.

Website: https://matthewsmawfield.github.io/TEP-GNSS-II/
